title: agentgw gateway config
description: The gateway's local config file (YAML or JSON; YAML is parsed as JSON). One gateway process serves one agent identity. Relative paths resolve against the config file's directory. Version 1 (rev 13, docs/adr/0013: upstreams[].auth kind authorization_code, token_file, issuer).

agent.description: Identity of the agent this gateway fronts. `agentgw run --agent X` overrides id.

currency.description: Currency of every price in this file. _meta.cost in another currency is rejected.

listen.description: Address for `agentgw serve` (Streamable HTTP), e.g. ":8080". Empty for stdio-only use.

upstreams.description: MCP servers behind the gateway. Exactly one of command or url per upstream; auth only with url. `agentgw run -- cmd` adds a stdio upstream named by --server (default 'default') without touching this list.

command.description: argv of a stdio MCP server.

path.description: Path prefix the gateway serves this upstream on in HTTP mode. Required with url.

auth.description: Credential the gateway holds for this url upstream (docs/adr/0012, 0013). The secret comes from secret_env or secret_file (exactly one for kind header and client_credentials; at most one for authorization_code), never from this file and never from the client: the client's Authorization header is dropped before forwarding. kind header: send `<header>: <prefix><secret>`. kind client_credentials: OAuth 2.0 client credentials grant (RFC 6749 4.4) at token_url, client_secret_basic, token cached until shortly before expires_in, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. kind authorization_code: browser login once with `agentgw login <name>` (PKCE, loopback redirect, discovery per RFC 9728/8414, dynamic registration when client_id is empty); tokens live in token_file and are refreshed by the gateway; refresh failure fails calls closed and asks for a new login. Any failure to produce the credential fails the call closed.

header.description: kind header: header name, e.g. Authorization or X-Api-Key.

prefix.description: kind header: prepended verbatim to the secret, e.g. "Bearer ". Default empty.

secret_env.description: Environment variable holding the header value (kind header) or the client secret (kind client_credentials; optional for authorization_code with a pre-registered confidential client_id). Must be set and non-empty at startup.

secret_file.description: File holding the secret, relative to the config file's directory. Trailing newline trimmed.

token_url.description: kind client_credentials: the token endpoint. (authorization_code discovers it.)

client_id.description: kind client_credentials: required. kind authorization_code: optional; empty means dynamic client registration (RFC 7591) at login; an HTTPS URL is passed verbatim (MCP Client ID Metadata Document).

scopes.description: kinds client_credentials and authorization_code: sent space-joined as `scope`. Omitted when empty (authorization_code then uses the server's advertised scopes).

resource.description: kinds client_credentials and authorization_code: RFC 8707 `resource` parameter. Omitted when empty for client_credentials; defaults to the protected-resource metadata's resource, else url, for authorization_code.

issuer.description: kind authorization_code: the authorization server (RFC 8414 issuer URL) login uses instead of the protected-resource metadata's authorization_servers[0]; the fetched metadata's issuer must equal it. Required when secret_env or secret_file is set (a configured secret must never be sent to a server the upstream chose), optional otherwise.

token_file.description: kind authorization_code: token file (contracts/schemas/token-file.schema.json) written by `agentgw login`, relative to the config file's directory. Default `<dir of state_path>/tokens/<name>.json`.

policy_path.description: Policy file (contracts/policy-yaml.md). A .cedar extension loads raw Cedar instead.

prices.description: Price table. Lookup: first item whose server and tool globs match, in file order; no match means zero. Estimate = per_call + value(arg_field) * arg_multiplier. value(): find the unique top-level key equal to arg_field, or failing that the unique key that matches it under the forwarding rule's collision relation (EqualFold after NFC; objects with colliding keys never reach the Pricer). Missing key: 0. JSON number: its value. JSON string: its value iff the whole string matches ^-?(0|[1-9][0-9]*)(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][+-]?[0-9]+)?$ (no surrounding whitespace, no leading +, no hex, no inf/nan, no separators) and parses to a finite double. Anything else that is present (other strings, booleans, null, arrays, objects, negative or non-finite values) is unpriceable: Estimate returns an error and the call is denied with evaluation-error. Amounts are decimal numbers in `currency` units; converted to micros with round-half-away-from-zero.

server.description: Glob; `*` matches any run of characters.

arg_field.description: Top-level argument field whose numeric value is multiplied. Empty disables.

redaction.description: Applied to stored args and results, recursively through objects and arrays. Built-in defaults always apply (see contracts/conventions.md); these lists add to them.

fields.description: Object keys (case-insensitive, any depth) whose value is replaced by the string "[REDACTED]".

patterns.description: Go RE2 regexps; every match inside a string value is replaced by "[REDACTED]".

approvals.description: Approval surfaces. cli is required; github is optional (rev 9, docs/adr/0011) and, when present, makes `agentgw run`/`serve` post held calls as comments and poll for replies. Slack arrives with a later bump.

token_path.description: Ed25519 approver token file. `agentgw approvals init` creates it. Also signs GitHub-comment decisions (the gateway holds this key and signs on the commenter's behalf).

github.description: Approvals by GitHub issue or pull-request comment. The token comes from the environment variable named by token_env, never from this file.

repo.description: owner/name of the repository whose issue or PR carries the conversation.

issue.description: Issue or pull-request number to comment on and poll. 0: take it from the GitHub Actions event file at $GITHUB_EVENT_PATH (.issue.number, else .pull_request.number); refuse to start if neither is present.

min_permission.description: Least repository role (GitHub role_name) a commenter needs for /approve or /deny to count. Default write.

poll_interval.description: Go duration between comment polls while an approval is pending. Default 15s, minimum 5s. No polling while nothing is pending.

token_env.description: Environment variable holding the GitHub token. Default GITHUB_TOKEN.

path.description: JSONL ledger file. Created if missing.

checkpoint_every.description: Append a checkpoint after this many entries since the last one.

key_path.description: Ed25519 ledger signing key. `agentgw keygen` creates it.

state_path.description: SQLite file shared by budgets and approvals (docs/adr/0003).
